|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 3) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Death Squadron Assignment (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-D-deathsquadronassignment-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-deathsquadronassignm022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/deathsquadronassignment.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Dark/large/deathsquadronassignment.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Death Squadron”. Text: “USED: Take a card with 'Death Squadron' in lore into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: Deploy an Imperial to a [Hoth] location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Death Squadron Assignment (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-deathsquadronassignm6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/deathsquadronassignment.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Dark/large/deathsquadronassignment.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). Text: “USED: Take a card with 'Death Squadron' in lore into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. LOST: Deploy an Imperial to a [Hoth] location from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
